```{r}
#| results: asis
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

PATH_INTERVALS <- "../scoring/ss_to_raw_intervals.csv"
intervals <- readr::read_csv(PATH_INTERVALS, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Keep only TR items 2..12
intervals_tr <- intervals %>%
  filter(str_starts(measure, "PercDevAbs_TR_")) %>%
  mutate(sec = as.integer(str_extract(measure, "\\d+$"))) %>%
  filter(sec >= 2, sec <= 12) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("TR ", sec))

# Cell formatting
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)

cell_string <- function(lo, hi, digits = 2) {
  if (is.infinite(hi)) return(paste0(fmt_num(lo, digits), "+"))
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(lo, hi))) return(fmt_num(lo, digits))
  paste0(fmt_num(lo, digits), " - ", fmt_num(hi, digits))
}

intervals_tr2 <- intervals_tr %>%
  mutate(cell = mapply(cell_string, raw_min, raw_max, SIMPLIFY = TRUE)) %>%
  select(age, ss_1_19, label, cell)

ages <- sort(unique(intervals_tr2$age))
ss_rows <- tibble(ss_1_19 = 19:1)

# -----------------------------
# First page: Italian explanation
# -----------------------------
cat("\\section*{Time Reproduction (TR), conversioni per i singoli item}\n\n")
cat("Questo documento contiene le tabelle di conversione per i singoli item di TR (durate 2--12 s) per ciascuna et\\`a.\n\n")
cat("\\subsection*{Nota pratica}\n\n")
cat("Per ottenere il \\textbf{totale TR} coerente con l'app, bisogna prima convertire ciascun item nel relativo SS e poi seguire la procedura di aggregazione descritta nel documento dei \\textbf{Totali}. In questo file trovi solo le conversioni dei 11 item.\n\n")
cat("\\newpage\n\n")

# -----------------------------
# Tables per age (portrait)
# -----------------------------
for (a in ages) {
  dat_a <- intervals_tr2 %>% filter(age == a)

  cat(sprintf("\\section*{Et\\`a %s anni}\n\n", a))

  # TR items 2..6
  tr_2_6 <- paste0("TR ", 2:6)
  tab_2_6 <- dat_a %>%
    filter(label %in% tr_2_6) %>%
    select(ss_1_19, label, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = cell, values_fill = "-") %>%
    right_join(ss_rows, by = "ss_1_19") %>%
    arrange(desc(ss_1_19)) %>%
    mutate(across(-ss_1_19, ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, "-")))

  cat("\\subsection*{TR item (2--6 s)}\n\n")
  cat(as.character(
    kable(tab_2_6, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "c",
          col.names = c("SS", names(tab_2_6)[-1])) |>
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7)
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  # TR items 7..12
  tr_7_12 <- paste0("TR ", 7:12)
  tab_7_12 <- dat_a %>%
    filter(label %in% tr_7_12) %>%
    select(ss_1_19, label, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = cell, values_fill = "-") %>%
    right_join(ss_rows, by = "ss_1_19") %>%
    arrange(desc(ss_1_19)) %>%
    mutate(across(-ss_1_19, ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, "-")))

  cat("\\subsection*{TR item (7--12 s)}\n\n")
  cat(as.character(
    kable(tab_7_12, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "c",
          col.names = c("SS", names(tab_7_12)[-1])) |>
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7)
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}

```
